rootCausesFixed.problem: endBlock/bonusEndBlock === 0 was treated as exhausted runway (remaining=0), so active emission pools were not classified as funded/rewarding
fix: derivePoolLifecycle funded/rewarding includes open-ended active emission

rootCausesFixed.problem: meta.active used else-if and excluded rewarding pools (active undercount)
rootCausesFixed.fix: active += 1 when pool.active || pool.rewarding; rewarding tallied separately

rootCausesFixed.problem: KPI Pools Rewarding trusted classification alone while Explore showed live SmartChef pools
rootCausesFixed.fix: usePoolsOverviewKpis uses Math.max(classified, live SmartChef lifecycle rewarding)

rootCause.detail: View Contract count was 0 because Explore/Featured rendered zero pool cards. Open-ended SmartChef pools (endBlock/bonusEndBlock<=0) were incorrectly marked ended (currentBlock>0) and not started (getPoolBlockInfo blocksRemaining=0), and Explore required status/display LIVE without accepting lifecycle.active/rewarding. Not a selector bug; not merely above-the-fold timing.

recovery.note: Classification API may 500 when all RPC endpoints fail; Explore/Featured use Redux SmartChef inventory with corrected open-ended lifecycle.
